description: REQ-P3a's acceptance criteria says "3ファイル × 3ディレクトリ × 3パス形式 = 27通りの grep 結果が記録されている" but neither the behavioral spec nor PROP-P3a in the verification architecture specifies a concrete artifact path or format where this 27-combination record is expected to live, so this specific acceptance-criterion clause (as opposed to the PASS/FAIL zero-hit logic itself, which is well-specified) cannot currently be checked by a deterministic shell assertion.
suggestedFix: Specify a concrete log path/format for the MOVE REF-CHECK guard's output (e.g. `.vcsdd/features/fable5-config-slimdown/reviews/move-ref-check.log` with one line per of the 27 grep invocations) so `tests/verify.sh` can assert the log exists and contains 27 recorded lines, in addition to the existing zero-hit assertion.
